import time

from cachestore import TTLCache


class FakeClock:
    """A clock that the tests move forward by hand."""

    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self.now = 1000.0

    def __call__(self) -> float:
        return self.now


def test_get_before_and_after_expiry():
    clock = FakeClock()
    cache = TTLCache(10, clock=clock)
    cache.set("k", "v")
    clock.now += 9.5
    assert cache.get("k") == "v"
    clock.now += 0.5
    assert cache.get("k") is None


def test_default_for_missing_key():
    assert TTLCache(10).get("nope", "fallback") == "fallback"


def test_delete_missing_key():
    cache = TTLCache(10)
    cache.delete("never-set")
    assert len(cache) == 0


def test_purge_counts_expired():
    clock = FakeClock()
    cache = TTLCache(5, clock=clock)
    cache.set("a", 1)
    clock.now += 3
    cache.set("b", 2)
    clock.now += 3
    assert cache.purge() == 1
    assert len(cache) == 1


def test_real_clock_expiry():
    cache = TTLCache(0.1)
    cache.set("k", "v")
    time.sleep(0.3)
    assert cache.get("k") is None


def test_has():
    clock = FakeClock()
    cache = TTLCache(10, clock=clock)
    cache.set("k", "v")
    assert cache.has("k") and not cache.has("other")
    clock.now += 10
    assert not cache.has("k")


def test_keys_are_sorted_and_live():
    clock = FakeClock()
    cache = TTLCache(10, clock=clock)
    cache.set("b", 1)
    clock.now += 6
    cache.set("a", 2)
    assert cache.keys() == ["a", "b"]
    clock.now += 6
    assert cache.keys() == ["a"]


def test_clear():
    cache = TTLCache(10)
    cache.set("k", "v")
    cache.clear()
    assert len(cache) == 0

import json
from pathlib import Path

import pytest

from cachestore import TTLCache, dump, load

NOW = 1767225600.0  # 2026-01-01 00:00:00 UTC
SNAPSHOTS = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent / "snapshots"


def test_load_sessions_snapshot():
    text = (SNAPSHOTS / "sessions-v1.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    cache = load(text, clock=lambda: NOW)
    assert cache.get("session:ana") == "tok-81f2"
    assert len(cache) == 2  # session:eli had expired before NOW


def test_round_trip():
    cache = TTLCache(30, clock=lambda: NOW)
    cache.set("a", [1, 2])
    assert load(dump(cache), clock=lambda: NOW).get("a") == [1, 2]


def test_unknown_version():
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        load(json.dumps({"entries": {}, "ttl": 1, "version": 9}))
